title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability… (CVE-2026-132733)
description: CVE-2026-132733 is a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the MediaWiki Math Extension affecting versions 1.43, 1.45, 1.46, and 1.47. It involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation in the src/SpecialMathWikibase.php file. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.1.
